    Institutional Governance

    Our 4 Operating Pillars for Montreal Facilities

    We eliminate co-liability risks for building owners and property managers while providing executive-level cleaning quality across every square foot.

    ⚖️
    Decree Wage Compliance

    CPEEP Montreal Parity

    Full compliance with the Parity Committee for the Building Services Sector in the Montreal region. Guaranteed legal wages ($23+/hr base) protect our clients from joint-liability lawsuits under the Quebec Collective Agreement Decrees Act and secure long-term, motivated teams.

    🛡️
    Financial Indemnity

    $5,000,000 Liability & Bonding

    We carry $5,000,000 in comprehensive commercial liability coverage — five times standard requirements — protecting commercial landlords, institutional asset managers, and condominium syndicates against property damage, key loss, and operational risk.

    🧪
    Health & Safety Standard

    CNESST & SIMDUT / WHMIS

    Flawless CNESST safety record. All technicians are SIMDUT/WHMIS trained. We employ standardized color-coded microfiber separation protocols to physically eliminate cross-contamination between sanitary restrooms, executive boardrooms, and communal cafeterias.

    ⚡
    Industrial Fleet & Tech

    Tennant® Fleet & HEPA Care

    Commercial battery-powered Tennant® walk-behind automatic scrubbers for high-traffic corridors, multi-stage HEPA filtration commercial vacuums, and neutral-pH UL-certified cleaners that protect terrazzo, polished concrete, vinyl, and stone finishes.

    Asset Protection & Integrity

    The OTIS 5-Point Security Protocol

    Corporate headquarters, medical clinics, and financial offices entrust us with after-hours facility access. Here is how we safeguard your premises:

    01

    Background Checked

    Every team member passes strict criminal background screening, reference verification, and identity audits before stepping foot in your facility.

    02

    Lockbox & Key Protocol

    Strict custodial protocols for keycards, lockbox codes, and after-hours alarm arming. Zero keys leave our supervisory chain of custody.

    03

    Dedicated Squads

    We assign the same uniformed personnel to your account every shift, ensuring thorough familiarity with your security perimeters and special instructions.

    04

    Digital Shift Logs

    Standardized digital shift reports and 50-point quality inspections conducted by field supervisors ensure accountability after every single visit.

    05

    100% Re-Clean Guarantee

    If an item flagged during inspection does not meet our rigorous benchmark, our dispatch team rectifies it within 24 hours at zero extra charge.
